dedupe_keys.name: turbine performance measurement using nacelle mounted lidars in complex terrain techniques for reducing uncertainty

description: Slinger and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed application evaluates a Scottish wind farm containing thirty 2.05 MW turbines, with twelve nacelle-mounted lidars used for flow assessment and model calibration. The source addresses induction correction in complex terrain. This is a specific measurement-informed CFD application. The separate UniTTe multi-campaign study shares methods but does not explicitly establish the same field campaign, so identical underlying observations are not asserted. Current raw-data access and universal calibration transfer are unspecified. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
